materials: select m.{{id:marketing_materials}} as id, m.name, m.material_type, m.material_type__label as type_label, m.product_category__label as category, m.folder, m.folder__label as folder_label, m.description, m.file, m.owner__label as owner_name, m.updated_at from marketing_materials m order by m.updated_at desc
documents: select d.{{id:documents}} as id, d.name, d.doc_type, d.doc_type__label as type_label, d.section, d.section__label as section_label, d.folder, d.folder__label as folder_label, d.notes, d.file, d.owner__label as owner_name, d.updated_at from documents d order by d.updated_at desc
options: select o.object_type_id, o.property, o.api_value, o.label from property_options o where o.object_type_id in ('{{code:marketing_materials}}', '{{code:documents}}') and o.property in ('material_type', 'doc_type', 'folder', 'section') and o.record_status = 'active' order by o.object_type_id, o.property, o.display_order
